summary: The native UI builds, but the accessibility test runner cannot establish an automation session on this Mac.
conditions: DevToolsSecurity reports that Developer mode is disabled.
The configured development team has no matching Mac Development signing identity on this host.
The ad-hoc-signed runner starts but times out while enabling automation mode.
resume_condition: Enable DevToolsSecurity with administrator authorization, install a valid Mac Development identity for the configured team, and rerun the recorded XCUITest command.
